items.name: Small Campfire
items.description: A few sticks and a stubborn flame. It is a start.

items.name: Simple Tunic
items.description: Plain homespun wool, patched at the elbows.

items.name: Traveler's Pack
items.description: Everything you own, carried on your back.

items.name: Walking Staff
items.description: An ash staff, good for hills and for bravado.

items.name: Log Seat
items.description: A fallen log dragged to the fire. Luxury.

items.name: Cooking Pot
items.description: A dented iron pot on a tripod. Pottage tonight.

items.name: Hooded Cloak
items.description: A green wool cloak against wind and rain.

items.name: Lean-to Shelter
items.description: Branches and a tarp. Better than sleeping in the rain.

items.name: Hunting Dagger
items.description: A short blade for rope, bread and emergencies.

items.name: Oil Lantern
items.description: A small light hung on a post. The night is less vast.

items.name: Leather Jerkin
items.description: Boiled leather armour, stiff and reassuring.

items.name: Loyal Hound
items.description: A scruffy dog who decided you were worth following.

items.name: Stone Fire Ring
items.description: A proper ring of stones and a fire that roars.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.description: Oak planks bound with iron. Painted with your colours.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.description: A true blade, balanced and bright.

items.name: Canvas Tent
items.description: A peaked canvas tent. Dry at last.

items.name: Trusty Horse
items.description: A patient bay mare who knows the road.

items.name: Chainmail Hauberk
items.description: Thousands of riveted rings. Heavy, and worth it.

items.name: Camp Banner
items.description: Your coat of arms, flying above the camp.

items.name: Wandering Merchant
items.description: A merchant has set up a stall at your camp. Trinkets and rumours.

items.name: Travelling Bard
items.description: A bard sings of your deeds. Mostly accurately.

items.name: Steel Helm
items.description: A polished nasal helm with a plume.

items.name: Great Bonfire
items.description: A bonfire that lights up the whole clearing.

items.name: Plate Armour
items.description: Gleaming plate, fitted by a master armourer.

items.name: Faithful Squire
items.description: A young squire who wants to hear every story.

items.name: Wooden Watchtower
items.description: A lookout tower over the camp. You can see for miles.

items.name: Heraldic Shield
items.description: A steel heater shield bearing your arms.

items.name: Palisade Wall
items.description: Sharpened stakes ring the camp. It has become a stronghold.

items.name: Grand Pavilion
items.description: A striped pavilion fit for a tournament champion.

items.name: Hunting Falcon
items.description: A falcon that circles overhead and returns to your arm.

items.name: Distant Keep
items.description: A stone keep on the hill, yours to hold. The traveler has found a home.
